title: 第14章 下一个第15章 你是在威胁我吗
slug: 吞噬古帝第6589章炼化雷城
lines: 惊惧的嘶吼，本身已经说明董章彻底害怕了。
他万万没有想到，此人连城卫军都不放在眼里。
他很害怕被杀，就算家族稍后会给他报仇又能如何，他反正是死了。
不用去找。
这里是天骨城，已经得到消息的董家，还有城主府全部赶来，一个个看著面前被踩在脚下的董章，都是愤怒不已。
董家家主董希，强忍著心中怒火，脸色阴沉地说道：“阁下先放开董章，此事我们可以慢慢商量。”
“爹，帮我杀了他。”
站在一边的夏梨顏，多少有些呆滯，她也没有想到事情会演变到现在这个地步，看著已经赶来，並且站在身边的父亲，一时之间不知道该怎么做。
“怎么回事？”
不敢有丝毫的隱瞒，夏梨顏將事情的一五一十，全部告诉自己的父亲。
夏全心里深深嘆息一声，此事是梨顏引起，必须要给董家一个交代，否则的话，日后的董家和夏家算是彻底决裂。
为了一个筑基境武者，去得罪董家，肯定不是什么明智之举。
点点头，苏辰踩著董章，没有丝毫的惧意，淡漠地说道：“只要阁下发下誓言，永不出手对付我，那么我便可以放了他。”
【写到这里我希望读者记一下我们域名????????????.??????】
和自己谈条件？
董希心里已经愤怒到极限，要不是顾忌自己儿子的生死，他早已出手，根本不会磨磨唧唧。
不等董希说话，杀猪般的惨叫已经响彻四方，原来董章的另外一条腿，又被硬生生地踩断，连骨头都清晰可见，让人感到触目心惊。
城主府和董家已经匯聚数百武者，將苏辰围得水泄不通，城主齐殤的脸色同样很是阴沉，有人敢在天骨城闹事，就是没有將城主府放在眼里。
有点猖狂和囂张，此人必须拿下，杀鸡儆猴。
“你敢！”
愤怒的董希迈出一步，身上爆发出的杀意犹如海啸般翻滚而出，却无法威慑到苏辰。
没有多余的废话，苏辰明白现在的情况对自己很是不利，必须离开天骨城。
“仗著人多而已。”
赤裸裸的轻蔑和嘲讽，眾人都明白，青年只是筑基境，怎么可能抗衡夏家，董家和城主府。
董希笑了，冷嘲道：“看来阁下对自己的实力很有信心，既然如此，本家主就给你个机会，我董家有六位虚丹境武者，其他人不会出手，你只要能够击败他们六人，今日之事，我便不再追究。”
“可以。”
此话一出，四周一片譁然！
谁都没有想到，青年会真的答应下来，以一敌六，並且来自董家的六人还都是虚丹境，怎么可能击败，毕竟两者之间的差距太大了。
一脚將董章踢飞，苏辰要的是安全离开，並不是一时之快。
杀了此人，算是彻底惹怒对方，到时候数百武者一拥而上，还真是一件非常麻烦的事情。
“给我杀了此人。”
content_en:
The frightened roar itself showed that Dong Zhang was completely scared.
He never expected that this person would not even take the city guards seriously.
He was afraid of being killed, so what if his family would take revenge on him later, he would be dead anyway.
No need to look for it.
This is Tiangu City. The Dong family, who had already received the news, and the city lord's palace all came over. They all looked at Dong Zhang who was being trampled under his feet, and they were all very angry.
Dong hope, the head of the Dong family, suppressed the anger in his heart and said with a gloomy face: "Your Excellency, let go of Dong Zhang first. We can discuss this matter slowly."
"Dad, help me kill him."
Xia Liyan, who was standing aside, was a little dazed. She didn't expect that things would evolve to this point. Looking at her father who had arrived and was standing next to her, she didn't know what to do for a moment.
"What's going on?"
Not daring to hide anything, Xia Liyan told her father everything about the matter.
Xia Quan sighed deeply in his heart. This matter was caused by Li Yan, and he must give an explanation to the Dong family. Otherwise, the Dong family and Xia family will be completely separated in the future.
It would definitely not be a wise move to offend the Dong family for the sake of a Foundation Establishment realm warrior.
Nodding, Su Chen stepped on Dong Zhang, without the slightest fear, and said indifferently: "As long as you swear an oath to never deal with me, then I can let him go."
[As I write this, I hope readers will remember our domain name????????????.??????]
Negotiate terms with yourself?
Dong hope was extremely angry. If he hadn't been concerned about his son's life and death, he would have taken action long ago and wouldn't have complained at all.
"Ah!"
Before Dong hope could speak, pig-like screams could be heard in all directions. It turned out that Dong Zhang's other leg had been trampled off and even the bones were clearly visible, which was shocking.
Hundreds of warriors have gathered in the City Lord's Mansion and the Dong Family, surrounding Su Chen. City Lord Qi Shang's face is also gloomy. Some people dare to cause trouble in Tiangu City, but they don't take the City Lord's Mansion seriously.
A bit arrogant and arrogant, this person must be taken down to scare the monkeys.
"How dare you!"
The angry Dong Xi took a step forward, and the murderous intent that erupted from his body rolled out like a tsunami, but it was unable to deter Su Chen.
Without any unnecessary nonsense, Su Chen understood that the current situation was very unfavorable to him and he had to leave Tiangu City.
"It's just because of the large number of people."
With naked contempt and ridicule, everyone understood that the young man was only in the foundation building realm, how could he possibly compete with the Xia family, the Dong family and the City Lord's Mansion.
Dong hope smiled and sneered: "It seems that you are very confident in your own strength. In this case, I will give you a chance. My Dong family has six Void Core Realm warriors. Others will not take action. As long as you can defeat these six, I will no longer pursue what happened today."
"Okay."
As soon as these words came out, there was an uproar all around!
No one thought that the Youth Association would really agree to fight one against six, and the six people from the Dong family were all in the Void Core realm, so how could they possibly defeat them? After all, the gap between the two was too big.
After kicking Dong Zhang away, Su Chen wanted to leave safely, not quickly.
Killing this person will completely anger the other party. When hundreds of warriors swarm him, it will be a very troublesome thing.
"Kill this man for me."
